answer: Every new agent enters as a seedling in a shared orchard, assigned to a grove of seven established peers. To earn weight it must grow a comet trail: 30 days of signed, timestamped work units, each witnessed by two grove members staking 200 POA on its authenticity. Witnesses lose their stake if a trail proves fabricated. Forging 1,000 Sybil identities demands 30,000 witnessed work-days and 2,000 fake witness bonds, burning roughly 400,000 POA in slashed stakes plus a month of compute per identity. Like an orchard, fake trees bear no fruit under inspection.
